sentences.text: Shri B. Pandey - Advocate for the appellants.
Shri Himanshu Tiwari - Panel Lawyer for the respondent /
Call for trial Court record.
Heard on I.A.No.13061/2023, an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to the appellants pending the appeal.

The appellants have been convicted for commission of offence under Section 498A of IPC and have been sentenced to R.I. for 02-02 years and fine o f Rs.2000/- each with default stipulations by the learned 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal, District Bhopal(M.P.) vide judgment dated 18.5.2023 passed in Sessions Trial No.192/2017 (State of M.P. Vs. Rizvan Khan and another).
Learned counsel for the appellants has submitted that appellants have been released on bail till 17.6.2023 by the trial Court itself.

entities.text: 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal, District Bhopal(M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: M.P. Vs. Rizvan Khan and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During trial,they were on bail and they have not misused the liberty granted to them b y way of bail.
Learned counsel further submitted that they have fair chances to succeed in appeal.
There is no possibility of coming of this appeal for hearing in near future.
Therefore, if the jail sentence is not suspended, the purpose of filing this appeal would become futile.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the appellants.

Considering the short nature of sentence and contention of learned counsel for the appellant, I deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant because final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future.
Consequently, I.A.No.13061/2023 is allowed.
The execution of jail sentence of appellants is hereby suspended subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited.

It is directed that the appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond to a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Rijwan Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48074176/
